enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed on the mattress with the light off. Close eyes. Pull the doona up over the shoulder. Breathe slowly and evenly. Turn onto the left side. Bend the knees. Slide the arm under the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Push the doona down to the waist. Turn back onto the back. Slide the hand under the pillow again. Adjust the pillow with both hands. Turn onto the left side again. Pull the doona back up to the chin. Keep eyes closed without waking.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up slowly, taking daily medication with a glass of water, and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Roll onto the back. Lift the phone off the bedside table and press the side button to check the time. Put the phone down. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor. Reach to the bedside table and pick up the pill bottle. Twist the cap open. Tip one tablet into the palm. Close the cap. Pick up the glass of water. Put the tablet in the mouth. Drink the water. Put the glass down. Stand up. Walk to the wardrobe. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a t-shirt and jeans. Pull off the sleep shirt. Pull on the t-shirt. Step into the jeans. Pull the jeans up. Button and zip the jeans. Pull on socks. Walk to the desk and pick up the phone. Walk to the bedroom door. Open the door. Turn off the bedroom light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Skipping breakfast as usual, boiling the kettle for a quick tea, checking the shift roster and the written chore agreement on the phone via WhatsApp, and having tea while Member 4 has breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Walk to the kettle. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard door. Take out a mug and a tea bag. Put the tea bag in the mug. Close the cupboard door. Open the cutlery drawer. Take out a spoon. Close the drawer. Pick up the phone. Open WhatsApp. Scroll the shift roster message. Tap the chore agreement message. Read the chore list. Put the phone down on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into the mug. Put the kettle back on the base. Say to Member 4: 'Morning, just tea for me.' Stir the tea with the spoon. Pick up the mug. Sit down at the kitchen table across from Member 4. Take sips of tea. Put the mug down. Pick up the phone and re-open WhatsApp. Scroll back to the roster. Put the phone down. Pick up the mug. Finish the tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Rinsing tea cup and quick tidy up
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the kitchen table. Pick up the mug. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mug under the water. Turn off the tap. Take the spoon and rinse it. Put the mug and spoon in the drying rack. Pick up the tea bag and drop it in the bin. Pick up the phone from the counter. Wipe the table spot with a cloth. Put the cloth back on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the bus stop and taking public transit to Monash University campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the house. Walk down the driveway to the footpath. Walk along the street toward the bus stop. Stop at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Open the transport app and check the bus arrival time. Put the phone back in the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the phone on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit in a seat by the window. Put the backpack on the lap. Take the phone out. Scroll through messages. Look up at the stop display. Stand up. Walk to the door. Tap the phone on the reader. Step off the bus. Walk along the campus path. Walk through the campus entrance. Walk to the lecture building. Open the door. Walk into the lecture room. Sit down at a desk. Put the backpack on the floor. Take out a notebook and pen. Place them on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Bachelor of Business lectures at Monash University
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at the desk. Open the notebook. Pick up the pen. Write the lecture title. Look at the projector screen. Write key points. Turn to the classmate on the left and ask: 'Did you catch that figure?' Copy the slide table into the notebook. Put the pen down. Pick up the phone. Take a photo of the slide. Put the phone down. Pick up the pen again. Write more notes. Underline the heading. Turn the page. Highlight a line with the highlighter. Put the highlighter down. Raise the hand to ask a question. Say: 'Can you repeat the last part?' Write the answer. Close the notebook at the end of the lecture. Put the notebook and pen into the backpack. Stand up. Push the chair in. Walk out of the lecture room.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the campus library and working through group project material with classmates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the library. Walk to a group table. Pull out a chair. Sit down. Take the laptop out of the backpack. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password. Open the group project document. Turn the laptop screen toward the classmate. Say: 'I'll take the market section, you do the numbers.' Scroll through the shared file. Type two paragraphs. Read the classmate's section on screen. Point at the screen. Say: 'Move this part up.' Drag the paragraph with the trackpad. Type a heading. Insert a bullet list. Save the file with Ctrl+S. Pick up the phone. Check the group chat. Type a reply. Put the phone down. Continue typing. Close the document. Shut the laptop lid. Stand up. Push the chair in.

enriched_activities.activity: Buying a cheap lunch on campus and eating it while catching up on messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the campus food outlet. Stand in the queue. Read the menu board. Step to the counter. Say: 'One chicken wrap, please.' Tap the phone on the payment reader. Take the wrapped item. Walk to a bench. Sit down. Unwrap the food. Take a bite. Pick up the phone. Open WhatsApp. Scroll the household group chat. Type a reply about the chore roster. Take another bite. Open the messages from the group project chat. Type a reply. Take another bite. Drink from the water bottle. Finish the food. Roll up the wrapper. Stand up. Walk to the bin. Drop the wrapper in the bin. Walk to the tutorial building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending a business tutorial and continuing group project work on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the tutorial room. Sit at a table. Take out the notebook. Take out the pen. Listen to the tutor. Write the tutorial exercise number. Work through the exercise in pairs. Turn to the partner and say: 'I'll do question two.' Write the answer. Compare answers with the partner. Raise the hand. Ask the tutor: 'Is the second calculation right?' Write the correction. Hand the notebook to the partner. Take it back. Put the pen down. Pack the notebook into the backpack. Stand up. Push the chair in. Walk out of the room. Walk to a study space. Sit down. Take out the laptop. Open the group project file. Edit the section. Save the file. Close the laptop. Pack it away. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Paying a utility bill in cash at the post office to keep bill payments simple and low-friction
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the post office. Open the door. Walk to the counter. Take the utility bill out of the backpack pocket. Place the bill on the counter. Say: 'I'd like to pay this bill in cash.' Take the wallet out of the pocket. Open the wallet. Count the notes. Hand the notes to the staff member. Take the receipt. Fold the receipt. Put the receipt and wallet into the pocket. Say: 'Thanks.' Walk to the door. Open the door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking public transit to the hospitality workplace
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bus stop. Stop at the stop. Take the phone out. Check the route on the transport app. Put the phone away. Step onto the bus. Tap the phone on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down. Put the backpack on the lap. Take out the phone. Open the shift roster. Put the phone away. Stand up at the stop. Tap off. Step off the bus. Walk along the street to the workplace. Open the staff door. Walk inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a hospitality shift, serving customers and helping in the front of house
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff room. Put the backpack in the locker. Put on the apron. Tie the apron strings at the back. Walk to the front of house. Pick up the order pad and pen. Walk to a table. Say: 'Hi, are you ready to order?' Write the order on the pad. Walk to the counter. Enter the order into the till. Press the total button. Pick up plates from the pass. Carry the plates to the table. Place the plates down. Say: 'Enjoy your meal.' Pick up the empty glasses from a table. Carry them to the wash area. Wipe a table with a cloth. Push chairs back in. Walk to a new table. Take the drink order. Pour water from the jug into a glass. Carry the glass to the table. Place it down. Pick up the order pad again.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a staff meal break during the hospitality shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff room. Untie the apron strings. Hang the apron on the hook. Open the locker. Take out the lunch box. Sit down on the staff chair. Open the lunch box lid. Pick up the fork. Eat the meal. Pick up the water bottle. Drink. Pick up the phone. Open WhatsApp. Scroll the household group chat. Type a short reply. Put the phone down. Finish the meal. Close the lunch box. Put the lunch box back in the locker. Stand up. Pick up the apron from the hook. Tie the apron strings at the back. Walk back to the front of house.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing the hospitality shift, clearing tables and restocking
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to a table. Pick up the dirty plates. Stack the plates. Carry the stack to the wash area. Put the plates down. Wipe the table with a cloth. Pick up the dirty glasses. Carry them to the wash area. Walk to the storeroom. Open the storeroom door. Pick up a box of napkins. Carry the box to the front counter. Open the box. Refill the napkin holder. Carry the empty box to the bin. Walk to the fridge. Open the fridge door. Take out two bottles of drink. Close the fridge door. Carry the bottles to the front fridge. Open the fridge door and place the bottles inside. Close the door. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Pick up the order pad. Take an order at table six. Enter the order into the till. Press the total button. Carry the drinks to the table. Place them down. Clear the next table. Carry the plates to the wash area. Wipe the last table. Push the chairs in. Walk to the staff room. Untie the apron. Hang the apron on the hook. Open the locker. Take out the backpack.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking and taking public transit home after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the staff door. Walk along the street to the bus stop. Stop at the bus stop. Take the phone out. Open the transport app and check the bus time. Put the phone away. Step onto the bus. Tap the phone on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down. Put the backpack on the lap. Take out the phone. Open WhatsApp and read the group chat. Put the phone away. Stand up at the stop. Tap off. Step off the bus. Walk along the street. Walk up the driveway. Open the front door. Close the door. Walk to Bedroom 5. Put the backpack on the floor.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Adjust the water temperature with the handle. Pull the shower diverter. Step into the shower. Wet the hair under the water. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Close the cap. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and body. Rinse off. Turn the handle to stop the water. Step out of the shower. Take the towel from the rail. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto it. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Hang the towel on the rail. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a book in bed to wind down, with the space heater on low
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 5. Press the space heater power button. Press the low heat button. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Pull back the doona. Lie down on the bed. Pull the doona up to the waist. Open the book to the bookmark. Read a page. Turn the page. Read another page. Turn the page. Adjust the pillow with one hand. Turn to the left side. Read on. Turn the page. Turn to the right side. Read on. Close the book at the bookmark. Put the book on the bedside table. Pick up the phone from the table. Press the side button and set the alarm. Put the phone down on the table. Reach down and press the space heater off button. Lie on the back. Pull the doona to the chin. Close the eyes.

Lie in bed with eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the left side. Bend the knees. Slide the hand under the pillow. Keep the doona over the shoulder. Turn onto the back. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the right side. Pull the doona up to the chest. Keep eyes closed. Adjust the pillow with one hand. Remain still with eyes closed.
